panels.title: Renders (1h / 24h / 7d)
panels.description: First views of open pages (pagent_pages_viewed_total) — the north-star 'active render' signal. Post-submit polling reads are excluded at the source.

panels.title: Funnel: created → viewed → submitted — interactive Pages (24h)
panels.description: Top-of-funnel (created) → render (viewed) → activation (submitted), scoped to interactive Pages (format=a2ui) since only interactive Pages can submit. Instant queries — one bar per stage.

panels.title: Render → submit activation (24h)
panels.description: Of interactive Pages that rendered, the share that got a user submission. Scoped to format=a2ui (document Pages cannot submit). Pre-deploy unlabeled submitted samples are excluded, so the first 24h after rollout under-reads slightly. Pre-v2 proxy — no per-user identity yet.

panels.title: Page views by type (24h)
panels.description: Interactive Pages (a2ui) vs document Pages (html) demand.

options.content:
**North-star: active Page views.** `pagent_pages_viewed_total` counts a Page fetch only while it is still `open` — the renderer's post-submit polling of the same endpoint is excluded at the source (app.ts). Document Pages are view-only and stay open, so every view of them counts as a render.

**Funnel + activation are interactive-Page scoped** — only interactive Pages can submit, so mixing Page types would structurally deflate activation as document usage grows.

**Pre-v2 limitation:** true *weekly active renderers* and *repeat rate* need per-user identity. Those land in **stage 2**, after v2 auth adds `owner_id` — then add per-owner active-renderer and week-2 repeat panels here.

Do **not** treat raw counts as adoption in isolation — watch the render→submit activation and the funnel shape.
